Overview

Tirana is a city in Tirana with a population of 418,000. The capital and largest city of Albania, a vibrant Mediterranean metropolis known for its colorful buildings, Skanderbeg Square, and the nearby Dajti Mountain. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
